page.content:
Hired killer in horsehide who comes to take Robin.

How Guy of Gisborne connects

  • Artist: Robin of Sherwood — Guy of Gisborne is hired to take Robin and dies in the attempt.
  • Artist: Sheriff of Nottingham — Gisborne works as the sheriff's contracted killer.

What is Guy of Gisborne?

Guy of Gisborne is the bounty hunter of a savage early ballad. He and Robin fight in the wood; Robin wins and uses the horsehide disguise against the sheriff.

Key threads lead to Robin of Sherwood and Sheriff of Nottingham.
